Narrative 2: I earned a standing ovation from friends and nearby onlookers, as I exhibited a challenging cheese-ball juggling routine, which I finished by catching all four cheddar balls in my mouth.
Choice 3: See if they stick to the ceiling
Narrative 3: My friends and I tested the stickiness of some complimentary cheese balls we received by throwing them against the ceiling at the mall. We were subsequently escorted out of the mall by mall security as cheese balls rained down upon us.
Narrative 4: On National Cheese Ball Day, I got some free cheese balls at the mall and gave all of them to my friends.

Author: RT
Title: April 18th
Body: April 18th has finally arrived, and now you have to decide what role you will play in National Velociraptor Awareness Day.
Choice 1: Buy 'Jurassic Park' for everyone I know
Narrative 1: To celebrate National Velociraptor Day, I purchased Jurassic Park on DVD for every one of my friends and family members.
Choice 2: Scare people from inside a dinosaur suit
Narrative 2: In honor of National Velociraptor Day, I wore a velociraptor suit downtown and jumped out from behind bushes to scare the people walking by.
Narrative 3: In honor of National Velociraptor Day, I wrote and performed a limerick at an open mic night. The poem read: There once in this world was a raptor, whose claws stuck fear in those captured. She now is extinct, at least I think, tonight let us drink in her honor!
Narrative 4: I opted out of celebrating National Velociraptor Awareness Day this year.

Author: eb
Title: April 19th
Body: In honor of National Garlic Day, some food-geek friends are inviting you over to help innovate new ways to make unique garlic-flavored foods.
Narrative 1: On National Garlic Day, I told my food-geek friends that a candied garlic cheesecake would make a very unique culinary invention.
Choice 2: Peanut butter and garlic jelly sandwich
Narrative 2: On National Garlic Day, I told my food-geek friends that a peanut butter and garlic jelly sandwich would make a very unique culinary invention.
Narrative 3: On National Garlic Day, I told my food-geek friends that garlic cloves dipped in dark chocolate would make a very unique culinary invention.
Narrative 4: On National Garlic Day, I told my food-geek friends that I prefer my garlic on toast, not in some crazy culinary concoction.

Author: RT
Title: April 20th
Body: In honor of National Look Alike Day, you want to dress up to look like a celebrity but not sure which one.
Narrative 1: I dressed up as Bad Bunny in honor of National Look-Alike Day. I think some people thought that I was really him!
Narrative 2: I dressed up as Post Malone in honor of National Look-Alike Day. I think some people thought that I was really him!
Narrative 3: I dressed up as Michael Jackson in honor of National Look-Alike Day. I got some really weird looks from some parents!
Narrative 4: I dressed up like Jason Momoa in honor of National Look-Alike Day. My friends told me I look more like the skinny-armed Jason Momoa from the Rocket Mortgage commercial.

Author: RT
Title: April 21st
Body: It's National Kindergarten Day, which evokes a discussion among you and some friends about all the essential life skills that children learn in kindergarten. One of your friends asks what critical things you believe kindergarteners are failing to learn in today's world.
Narrative 1: I told my friends that there are far too many adults in this world that seem to have never learned the golden rule. Apparently, they don't understand how karma works.
Narrative 2: I told my friends that there are far too many adults in this world who never learned how to share. Don't they know that sharing is caring?
Narrative 3: I told my friends that there are far too many adults in the world who never seemed to learn the fact that life isn't fair.
Narrative 4: I told my friends that there are far too many adults in the world who never quite grasped the fundamentals of basic handwashing.

Author: eb
Title: April 22nd
Body: Yay, it's Earth Day today! You're super excited to get outside and do something good for the Earth, but having trouble deciding which planet-friendly project would be best.
Narrative 1: I celebrated Earth Day by planting a tree.
Narrative 2: On Earth Day, I built a beehive to help offset the world's dwindling bee population.
Narrative 3: I celebrated Earth Day by starting my very own compost pile!
Narrative 4: I planted a garden with both vegetables and flowers to celebrate Earth Day.

Author: RT
Title: April 23rd
Body: People around the world are celebrating International Nose Picking Day today, and you're in a conundrum on how to best celebrate the festive annual event.
Choice 1: Use a tissue to clear 'em out
Narrative 1: I picked my nose in honor of International Nose Picking Day, but I used a tissue to keep the gross stuff off of my fingers.
Narrative 2: I went digging for gold in my nose, without protection, in honor of International Nose Picking Day. The booger farm under my chair is growing by the day!
Narrative 3: I decided to stick my finger up my friend's nose, unsolicited, in honor of International Nose Picking Day. He then elbowed me in the stomach, leaving me in a heap of pain on the floor.
Narrative 4: On International Nose Picking Day, I decided that I'd never, in any way, or for any reason, celebrate anything by picking my nose.

Author: RT
Title: April 24th
Body: You're celebrating National Pigs-in-a-Blanket Day by munching on some of the aforementioned treats, when you start to ponder the best ways to consume hot dogs.
CTA: How are hot dogs best served?
Narrative 1: I spent all day eating pigs-in-a-blanket after I determined that the unique cooking method exalts the humble hot dog into its fullest expression.
Narrative 2: On National Pigs in a Blanket Day, I reaffirmed that the best way to consume hot dogs continues to be on a hot dog bun, with ketchup and mustard.
Narrative 3: On National Pigs in a Blanket Day, I discovered that a hot dog wrapped in a tortilla is a delicious way to consume a wiener.
Narrative 4: On National Pigs in a Blanket Day, I decided that hot dogs are actually the best when sliced up in baked beans and served warm.

Author: eb
Title: April 25th
Body: A friend of yours has a shortwave radio, and in honor of International Marconi Day today, he wants to broadcast a program with you as a special guest talking about anything you want.
CTA: What will you choose to discuss?
Narrative 1: On International Marconi Day, I was a special guest on a shortwave radio program, and I talked about the wonder and greatness of dogs for the entire hour.
Narrative 2: On International Marconi Day, I was a special guest on a shortwave radio program, and I shared with the listeners all of my favorite fast food restaurants, meals, combos, and sides for the entire hour.
Narrative 3: On International Marconi Day, I was a special guest on a shortwave radio program, and I talked about the ethereal essence of love for the entire hour.
Narrative 4: On International Marconi Day, I was a special guest on a shortwave radio program, and I seized the opportunity to proclaim the greatness and beauty of BTS. Go ARMY!

Author: eb
Title: April 26th
Body: Your friend has a friend who is a yoga instructor, and she's giving out free lessons today, in honor of National Pretzel Day, teaching people how to twist themselves into a legit pretzel. Your friend says it sounds fun and wants you to join her.
Narrative 1: I joined a yoga class on National Pretzel Day and learned how to twist myself into a legit pretzel.
Narrative 2: I told my friend that National Pretzel Day was not about twisting your body into dangerous contortions, but rather a celebration of the popular crunchy snack food.
Narrative 3: On National Pretzel Day, I declined my friend's invitation to join a yoga class teaching pretzel-shaped body contortions, but I did offer some rock salt for comedic effect.
Narrative 4: On National Pretzel Day, I declined my friend's invitation to join a yoga class teaching pretzel-shaped body contortions, because I don't like pretzels, and I'd never want to become one.

Author: RT
Title: April 27th
Body: It's National Prime Rib day today, and you're having some carnivorous friends over to celebrate the delicious succulence of slow-roasted meat. But before they arrive, you must decide which sauce will best compliment the dish.
Narrative 1: I served my friends prime rib with a creamy horseradish sauce as we honored the great National Prime Rib Day holiday.
Narrative 2: I served my friends prime rib with a savory au jus as we honored the great National Prime Rib Day holiday.
Narrative 3: I served my friends prime rib with ketchup as we honored the great National Prime Rib Day holiday.
Narrative 4: I served my friends prime rib without a sauce because I didn't want it to take away from the beef's natural flavors.

Author: RT
Title: April 28th
Body: You and some friends are hanging out at your house when someone notices it's National Superhero Day today. To celebrate, your friends are asking you to play the greatest superhero movie of all time.
Narrative 1: I put on 'The Dark Knight' so my friends and I could watch the greatest superhero movie ever made.
Narrative 2: I put on 'Black Panther' so my friends and I could watch the greatest superhero movie ever made.
Narrative 3: I put on 'Avengers: Infinity Wars' so my friends and I could watch the greatest superhero movie ever made.
Narrative 4: I told my friends that I'm not really into superheros and I didn't have a movie to watch in honor of National Superhero Day.

Author: RT
Title: April 29th
Body: In honor of International Dance Day, you and some friends decide it will be fun to do a flash mob performance in a public setting. As the leader, your friends want you to decide which song would be best to perform.
Choice 1: Chained to the Rhythm' by Katy Perry
Narrative 1: I participated in a flash mob performance with some friends on the steps of the courthouse. We did an impressive version of 'Chained to the Rhythm' by Katy Perry, which we played on a trumpet, while tap dancing in Power Ranger costumes.
Choice 2: Body Like a Back Road' by Sam Hunt
Narrative 2: My friends and I performed a flash mob rendition of 'Body Like a Back Road' by Sam Hunt during Bingo hour at a local retirement community. We really got the old-timers going as we did the 'Cowboy Cha Cha' dressed as nuns and priests.
Choice 3: Starboy' by The Weeknd feat. Daft Punk
Narrative 3: My friends and I did a flash mob performance of 'Starboy' by the Weeknd at a local spelling bee after Tyrone Jones correctly spelled the word "salmon" to win the tournament. Our performance was tremendous, but it was clear that Tyrone's impeccable spelling skills made him the true starboy of the show.
Narrative 4: I had to let my friends know that I didn't have the time or energy to do a flash mob performance for International Dance Day.

Author: RT
Title: April 30th
Body: Hairstyle Appreciation Day is here, and to celebrate, you've decided when you see someone with a fabulous hairdo, you'll bombard them with a shower of honest compliments.
Narrative 1: I celebrated Hairstyle Appreciation Day by letting an older gentleman know how much I adored his clever and cute comb-over hairstyle.
Narrative 2: I celebrated Hairstyle Appreciation Day by telling a young man, who was rocking out to some country music, how much I admired his impressive mullet hairstyle.
Narrative 3: I celebrated Hairstyle Appreciation Day by approaching a middle-aged man downtown and telling him how much respect I had for his perfectly symmetrical bowl-cut hairstyle.
Narrative 4: I celebrated Hairstyle Appreciation Day by approaching a college student on campus and telling him how much I appreciated the mesmerizing maze of cornrows on his head.

Author: RT
Title: May 1st
Body: It's May 1st, meaning that Couples Appreciation Day has arrived. You are considering all of the potential ways that you can show your special love for <lover>.
Narrative 1: I gave <lover> a bouquet of a dozen red roses to demonstrate my love on Couple Appreciation Day.
Narrative 2: I gave <lover> a foot massage to show <him/her> that I appreciate <him/her> so much that I'm willing to rub down <his/her> disgusting feet.
Choice 3: Tell <him/her> that I love <his/her> sweet cheeks
Narrative 3: I told <lover> that I love <his/her> sweet cheeks as a way to participate in Couple Appreciation Day.
Narrative 4: I didn't participate in Couple Appreciation Day because I couldn't think of anything I appreciate about <lover>.

Author: RT
Holiday Name: Take a Baby to Lunch Day
Title: May 2nd
Body: It's Take a Baby to Lunch Day today, and your friend is asking if you'd like to take her baby boy out for lunch while she gets a much-needed nap.
Narrative 1: I took my friend's baby boy to a McDonald's in honor of Take a Baby to Lunch Day. He seemed to have the time of his life as I fed him French fries and let him explore in the PlayPlace.
Narrative 2: I took my friend's baby boy to a steakhouse in honor of Take a Baby to Lunch Day. He wasn't interested in the filet mignon, but he did crush some crackers and milk.
Narrative 3: I took my friend's baby boy to Babies R Us in honor of Take a Baby to Lunch Day. I learned the hard way that Babies R Us doesn't have a lunch menu!
Narrative 4: I explained to my friend that I couldn't take her baby boy to lunch in honor of Take a Baby to Lunch Day.

Author: RT
Title: May 3rd
Body: It's National Paranormal Day today, and you couldn't be more excited about the prospect of having a spooky, abnormal experience.
Narrative 1: My friends and I performed a seance in a haunted property as a way to celebrate National Paranormal Day. But suddenly all of the candles went out at the exact same moment, and we ran out of the house screaming, never to return again.
Narrative 2: In honor of National Paranormal Day, my friends and I went into the woods in search of greys, reptilians, and little green men, but only came away with disappointment.
Narrative 3: I celebrated National Paranormal Day with a psychic reading from Madam Ruby. She told me that my future wasn't looking so bright, and death may be looming.
Narrative 4: I chose not to celebrate National Paranormal Day, but I did have some funny dreams about Hormone Monsters.

Author: RT
Title: May 4th
Body: Star Wars Day has finally arrived! Now you must tap into the force and determine which character you will be as you go about your school day.
Choice 1: Make the school my empire as Darth Vader
Narrative 1: I wore a very realistic Darth Vader costume to school in honor of Star Wars Day. I told my teacher that his lack of faith in me was disturbing and to be careful to not choke on his aspirations. He started crying, so I capped off my performance by telling him, "I am your father!"
Narrative 2: I wore a very realistic Yoda costume to school in honor of Star Wars Day. When my teacher assigned homework, I told her, "Fear is the path to the dark side. Fear leads to anger. Anger leads to hate. Hate leads to suffering." I then added that, "homework leads to fear." Understand, she did. The homework, she canceled.
Narrative 3: I wore a very realistic Chewbacca costume to school in honor of Star Wars Day. When the teacher assigned homework, I responded by saying, "GGGWARRRHHWWWW!" She then told me to quiet down, so I said, "AAARARRRGWWWH!"
Narrative 4: I attempted to come up with a cool costume to wear to school in honor of Star Wars Day but just couldn't muster up the force. When I tried explaining that to my teacher, he responded by saying, "No! Try not. Do. Or do not. There is no try".

Author: RT
Title: Cinco de Mayo
Body: It's Cinco de Mayo today, but with so many delicious Mexican dishes and just one holiday to celebrate, you're having a difficult time deciding which one sounds best.
Narrative 1: I decided that I would celebrate Cinco de Mayo by devouring three soft-shell fish tacos, complemented by a side of refried beans and Spanish rice.
Narrative 2: I decided that I would celebrate Cinco de Mayo by enjoying a savory steak burrito, with a side of tortilla chips and spicy salsa.
Narrative 3: I decided that I would celebrate Cinco de Mayo by eating a extremely cheesy, chicken quesadilla with sides of guacamole and sour cream.
Narrative 4: I didn't have any Mexican food in honor of Cinco de Mayo, but I did enjoy a Corona. The beer, not the virus!

Author: RT
Title: May 6th
Body: You're at a coffeehouse downtown with some friends on National Tourist Appreciation Day when the conversation arises about which characteristic makes it easiest to identify a tourist.
Narrative 1: I told my friends that the easiest way to identify a tourist is by the paper maps they sometimes use. Don't they have smartphones?!
Narrative 2: I told my friends that the easiest way to identify a tourist is by the huge cameras they have hanging around their necks. What's wrong with their phone cameras?
Narrative 3: I told my friends that the easiest way to identify a tourist is by the clothing they wear. Their fashion styles are definitely foreign around here!
Narrative 4: I told my friends that the easiest way to identify a tourist is by the big bags they lug around with them.

Author: RT
Title: May 7th
Body: You're having dinner with friends on National Tourism Day, and everyone is sharing fun and exciting travel stories. The question arises as to what is the best aspect of travel?
Narrative 1: I told my friends that the best part of traveling is going to places that I've never been, and seeing things that I may never see again.
Narrative 2: I told my friends that the best part of traveling is tasting new foods, hearing different languages and music, and learning about the history of various cultures around the world.
Narrative 3: I told my friends that the best part of traveling is getting away from my hometown and responsibilities for a while.
Narrative 4: I told my friends that a wise man once said, "travel is the antidote to ignorance," but I find travel to be expensive and exhausting, so I guess that makes me an ignorant fool.

Author: RT
Title: May 8th
Body: You're at a diner with some friends ordering drinks when the server informs you it's National Have a Coke Day today.
Narrative 1: I ordered a good ol' fashioned Coca Cola Classic while eating at a diner with friends, in honor of National Have a Coke Day.
Narrative 2: I ordered a Diet Coke while eating at a diner with friends, in honor of National Have a Coke Day.
Narrative 3: I chose Pepsi over Coke when eating at a diner with some friends on National Have a Coke Day. I'm a contrarian, and I like my soda super sweet!
Narrative 4: Even though it was National Have a Coke Day, I chose to drink water while eating at a diner with some friends.

Author: RT
Holiday Name: Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day
Title: May 9th
Body: You've been waiting all year, and the big day has finally arrived! It's Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day today, and now it's time to decide how you will best celebrate this special day.
Choice 1: Go to a mattress store and tear away
Narrative 1: I went to a mattress store, and while the associates weren't looking, I tore off as many tags as I could, before being chased out of the store. It was my way of celebrating Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day.
Choice 2: Make a tag-tearing social media post
Narrative 2: I made a funny TikTok video of me pulling the tags off my mattress in honor of Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day. It received a ton of likes and hilarious comments.
Choice 3: Start a petition to legalize tag tearing
Narrative 3: I started a petition online to legalize the tearing off of mattress tags. It was my way of honoring Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day.
Narrative 4: I chose to respect the tags, and the law, by not tearing tags off mattresses on Tear the Tags Off the Mattress Day.

Author: RT
Title: May 10th
Body: It's National Clean Your Room Day today, and as you sit in your messy bedroom, you begin to question the reasons why someone would want to make their bed every day.
Narrative 1: I decided that the best reason for making your bed every day is because it looks nice.
Choice 2: It starts the day off productively
Narrative 2: I decided that the best reason for making your bed every day is because it starts the day off productively. "If you want to change the world, start off by making your bed every day," is what I always say.
Narrative 3: I decided that the best reason for making your bed every day is because it discourages napping during the day.
Narrative 4: I couldn't come up with any good reasons why a person should make their bed every day. Dumbest. Chore. Ever.

Author: RT
Holiday Name: National Eat What You Want Day
Title: May 11th
Body: You just woke up and discover on your news feed that today is National Eat What You Want Day. Your mind starts racing as you think about the potential meals you could line up for the day.
Narrative 1: I respected National Eat What You Want Day by consuming bacon and eggs for breakfast, pepperoni pizza for lunch, and chicken and waffles for dinner.
Choice 2: Pancakes, mac & cheese, and pad Thai
Narrative 2: I respected National Eat What You Want Day by consuming pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast, baked mac & cheese for lunch, and spicy pad Thai for dinner.
Narrative 3: I respected National Eat What You Want Day by consuming half a dozen mixed donuts for breakfast, beef street tacos for lunch, and a grilled ribeye for dinner.
Choice 4: Oatmeal, soup, and a vegan chopped salad
Narrative 4: I respected National Eat What You Want Day by consuming a bowl of steel cut oats with cinnamon for breakfast, a savory vegetarian soup for lunch, and a vegan chopped salad for dinner.

Author: RT
Title: May 12th
Body: It's National Limerick Day, and you've been asked to write a limerick for the poetry event at your school.
Narrative 1: I wrote a limerick for a poetry event at my school. It went like this, "There is a great game known as BitLife, in which you can marry a hot wife. She may be crazy, and if you are lazy, you may end up dead from a knife".
Narrative 2: I wrote a limerick for a poetry event at my school. It went like this, "I once tried to steal a sedan, but I was seen by a blind man. I went to jail, with no chance for bail, a BitLife that strayed from the plan".
Narrative 3: I wrote a limerick for a poetry event at my school. It went like this, "A Bitizen, I'm proud to be. What is the status of thee? It's a small price to pay, for this great game to play. There's no doubt that you would agree"!
Narrative 4: I wrote a limerick for a poetry contest at my school. It went like this, "BitLife is a popular game, in it you may seek out fame. You may go far, and become a huge star, to miss out would be a great shame".

Author: RT
Title: May 13th
Body: You're just waking up when you suddenly remember that today is National Leprechaun Day. To celebrate, you decide it will be a lot of fun to dress up as a leprechaun all day.
Narrative 1: I dressed as Lucky the Boston Celtic in honor of National Leprechaun Day. I got punched in the nose by a Los Angeles Lakers fan while walking down the street, so it turned out to be a rather unlucky day.
Narrative 2: I had a blast dressed up as Leprechaun from the 'Leprechaun' movies. I spent the entire day scaring people in honor of National Leprechaun Day.
Narrative 3: I dressed as Lucky from Lucky Charms in honor of National Leprechaun Day. I tripped and fell twice, and also dropped my phone in a lake, so it turns out I wasn't so lucky.
Narrative 4: I decided not to participate in National Leprechaun Day.

Author: eb
Title: May 14th
Body: It's Chicken Dance Day, and you're super excited to join some friends in a flash-mob style chicken dance, but they're looking to you for suggestions on where will be the best place to perform the fowl dance.
Narrative 1: On Chicken Dance Day, I joined some friends in a flash-mob style chicken dance at a random courthouse wedding.
Narrative 2: On Chicken Dance Day, I joined some friends in a flash-mob style chicken dance at a local butcher shop.
Narrative 3: On Chicken Dance Day, I joined some friends in a flash-mob style chicken dance at a Chick-fil-A restaurant.
Narrative 4: On Chicken Dance Day, I joined some friends in a flash-mob style chicken dance on a farmer's front porch.

Author: RT
Title: May 15th
Body: Today is International Day of Families, and you can't help but reflect on all of the great families you've watched on TV and in movies over the years. You start to think about which family you would most like to be a part of in an imaginary universe.
Narrative 1: I decided that if I could be a part of any TV or movie family, it would be the Kardashians. Maybe I can find a way to marry in, at least for a few months?
Narrative 2: I decided if I could be a part of any fictional family, it would be the Simpsons. Never aging would definitely be an added bonus of being in this great family.
Narrative 3: I decided that if I could be a part of any fictional family, it would be the Modern Family. What a fun group to be around!
Narrative 4: I decided that if I could be a part of any fictional family it would be the Grinch family. Life in solitude with just a dog sounds pretty nice to me!

Author: RT
Title: May 16th
Body: In honor of National Mimosa Day, you join some friends at an all-you-can-eat brunch buffet that includes bottomless mimosas. As you're all gorging on delicious foods and desserts while sipping cocktails, a discussion arises over what is the ideal ratio of orange juice to champagne in a mimosa.
Narrative 1: On National Mimosa Day, I told my friends that the ideal mimosa is a perfectly even blend of OJ and champagne. Balance is key in life!
Narrative 2: On National Mimosa Day, I told my friends that the best way to make a mimosa is using 75% orange juice and 25% champagne. I gotta' get my vitamin C!
Narrative 3: On National Mimosa Day, I told my friends that the best way to make a mimosa is to make it 25% orange juice and 75% champagne. I want a cocktail, not a soft drink!
Narrative 4: On National Mimosa Day, I told my friends that I'll pass on the mimosas and drink 100% orange juice. Freshly squeezed please!

Author: eb
Title: May 17th
Body: On National Walnut Day, you discover that <friend> doesn't like the crunchy, nutty, goodness of walnuts, so you decide to bake something with walnuts in it, hoping you'll change <his/her> mind.
Narrative 1: On National Walnut Day, I tried to get my friend to like walnuts by baking some delicious chocolate chip walnut cookies, but sadly, it didn't work.
Narrative 2: On National Walnut Day, I tried to get my friend to like walnuts by baking some delicious dark chocolate walnut brownies, but sadly, it didn't work.
Narrative 3: On National Walnut Day, I tried to get my friend to like walnuts by baking a mocha walnut pie, but sadly, it didn't work.
Narrative 4: On National Walnut Day, I tried to get my friend to like walnuts by baking some maple walnut fudge, but sadly, it didn't work.

Author: RT
Title: May 18th
Body: It's time to celebrate No Dirty Dishes Day by not dirtying any dishes.
CTA: How will you go about it?
Narrative 1: I celebrated National No Dirty Dishes Day by eating out every single meal. It was costly, but easy!
Narrative 2: I celebrated National No Dirty Dishes Day by using disposable kitchenware, which I threw away after using. My environmentally conscious side felt a bit guilty!
Narrative 3: I celebrated National No Dirty Dishes Day by fasting for the day. No food meant no dishes!
Narrative 4: I did all kinds of cooking and cleaning instead of participating in National No Dirty Dishes Day.

Author: RT
Title: May 19th
Body: It's National Devil's Food Cake Day today, and you and <lover> are engaged in an intimate discussion about how this decadent dessert might have earned its name.
Narrative 1: I whispered in <lover-possessive> ear that devil's food cake earned its moniker due to its diabolically-high calorie content.
Choice 2: It's the opposite of angel food cake
Narrative 2: I whispered in <lover-possessive> ear that devil's food cake earned its moniker by being the opposite of angel food cake.
Narrative 3: I whispered in <lover-possessive> ear that devil's food cake earned its moniker for being so freaking addicting.
Narrative 4: I whispered in <lover-possessive> ear that I had no idea why devil's food cake is called devil's food cake.

Author: RT
Title: May 20th
Body: Today is Flower Day, which naturally causes you to reflect upon all the wonderful and amazing benefits that flowers provide.
CTA: What is the best thing about flowers?
Narrative 1: On Flower Day, I decided the best thing about flowers is the amazing landscapes they create, with fragrant aromas and bright colors.
Narrative 2: On Flower Day, I decided the best thing about flowers is how so many of them will sacrifice their lives as a way for humans to show their love for one another.
Narrative 3: On Flower Day, I decided the best thing about flowers is the wondrous relationship they have with bees. Harmony in nature at its finest.
Narrative 4: On Flower Day, I couldn't think of anything I liked about flowers because they have sharp thorns and give me allergies.

Author: eb
Title: May 21st
Body: It's National Waitstaff Day, and you want to pay your respects to those in the service industry by patronizing a favorite restaurant and complimenting your server's most admirable traits.
Narrative 1: I went to a French restaurant on National Waitstaff Day and complimented my server on how elegantly he presented our Duck a l'Orange.
Narrative 2: I went to a Chinese restaurant on National Waitstaff Day and complimented my server on how quick and efficient he was while serving us the most delicious Peking duck ever.
Narrative 3: I went to a barbecue restaurant on National Waitstaff Day and complimented my server on how cleanly he served us the sauciest, most delicious barbecue ribs ever.
Narrative 4: I went to a mom-and-pop restaurant on National Waitstaff Day and complimented my hosts for being the backbone of local culinary cuisine.

Author: RT
Title: May 22nd
Body: International Day for Biological Diversity has arrived, giving humans around the globe an opportunity to reflect on the state of the Earth. Naturally, you begin to think about how you can participate in this important day.
Narrative 1: I went to an environmental rally on International Day for Biological Diversity. My environmentally conscious friends and I listened to informative experts speaking on the topic, and we got really excited about biological diversity.
Narrative 2: I volunteered to assist in an environmental clean-up on International Day for Biological Diversity. All of those present saw, first hand, the adverse effects that humans can have on biological diversity, but we also experienced the power of people in numbers.
Choice 3: Watch a documentary about the topic
Narrative 3: I watched a nature documentary called 'Seven Worlds, One Planet' in honor of International Day for Biological Diversity. It was breathtaking!
Narrative 4: I decided not to celebrate International Day for Biological Diversity this year. Maybe I'll participate next year.

Author: RT
Title: May 23rd
Body: You're hanging out with a group of friends when one of them pulls out a sack of candy. She informs you that it is National Taffy Day today and asks which type of taffy you like the most.
Narrative 1: I ate some salt water taffy my friend gave me on National Taffy Day, and it made me wonder if it's actually made using seawater.
Narrative 2: My friend gave me some Laffy Taffy on National Taffy Day. I shook that Laffy Taffy, then I ate it!
Narrative 3: I ate some Bit-O-Honey that my friend gave me on National Taffy Day. It was the bee's knees!
Narrative 4: I passed when my friend offered me some candy on National Taffy Day. Where is the good candy?!

Author: eb
Title: May 24th
Body: It's National Brother's Day today, which causes you to reflect upon the many endearing ways that brothers greet each other, and which one you like the most.
Narrative 1: On National Brother's Day, I spent some time reflecting on the many endearing ways that brothers greet each other and determined that I liked "bro" the best.
Narrative 2: On National Brother's Day, I spent some time reflecting on the many endearing ways that brothers greet each other and determined that I liked "bruh" the best.
Narrative 3: On National Brother's Day, I spent some time reflecting on the many endearing ways that brothers greet each other and determined that I liked "brotha" the best.
Narrative 4: On National Brother's Day, I spent some time reflecting on the many endearing ways that brothers greet each other and determined that I liked "brother" the best.

Author: eb
Title: May 25th
Body: Your neighbor is a total wine snob who is always flaunting his geeky knowledge. In honor of National Wine Day today, he offers you mad respect if you can name which red grape makes Burgundy wine.
Narrative 1: On National Wine Day, I lost all respect from my wine-snob neighbor when I said Burgundy wines were made from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The correct answer was Pinot Noir.
Narrative 2: On National Wine Day, I lost all respect from my wine-snob neighbor when I said Burgundy wines were made from Syrah grapes. The correct answer was Pinot Noir.
Narrative 3: On National Wine Day, I earned mad respect from my wine-snob neighbor when I correctly identified Pinot Noir as the grape used in making red Burgundy wine.
Narrative 4: On National Wine Day, I told my wine-geek neighbor that I didn't know and didn't care what grapes are in what wines and that he should keep his condescending attitude to himself.

Author: eb
Title: May 26th
Body: You're hanging out with some friends on National Paper Airplane Day when a debate erupts over which attribute makes the best paper airplane.
Narrative 1: On National Paper Airplane Day, I told my friends that distance is the most valuable attribute of a paper airplane.
Narrative 2: On National Paper Airplane Day, I told my friends that time aloft is the most valuable attribute of a paper airplane.
Narrative 3: On National Paper Airplane Day, I told my friends that acrobatics is the most valuable attribute of a paper airplane.
Narrative 4: On National Paper Airplane Day, I told my friends that the type of paper used is the most valuable attribute of a paper airplane.

Author: eb
Title: May 27th
Body: In honor of National Sunscreen Day, your artist friend wants to recreate a famous work of art on your back using different SPF sunscreens and then have you lie on your stomach in the sun for two hours till it appears.
CTA: Which work of art will you choose?
Narrative 1: On National Sunscreen Day, my artist friend recreated Banksy's Balloon Girl on my back using various SPF sunscreens and then had me lie on my stomach in the sun for two hours till it appeared.
Narrative 2: On National Sunscreen Day, my artist friend recreated Van Gogh's Sunflowers on my back using various SPF sunscreens and then had me lie on my stomach in the sun for two hours till it appeared.
Narrative 3: On National Sunscreen Day, my artist friend recreated Picasso's Guernica on my back using various SPF sunscreens and then had me lie on my stomach in the sun for two hours till it appeared.
Narrative 4: On National Sunscreen Day, my artist friend wanted to recreate a famous work of art on my back using various SPF sunscreens, but I refused because it sounded dangerous to my skin.

Author: RT
Title: May 28th
Body: On National Hamburger Day, you find yourself in a heated debate with some friends over which fast-food burger joint has the best social media account.
Narrative 1: I told my friends that when it comes to social media, Wendy's is a savage's savage. Always fresh, never frozen, is how I prefer my tweets!
Narrative 2: I told my friends that when it comes to social media, McDonald's lacks nourishing content, but that shower of salty fries I see on Instagram gives me a Big Mac attack every time.
Narrative 3: I told my friends that when it comes to social media, Burger King keeps it fresh with those mouth-watering photos.
Choice 4: I'm not interested in fast food
Narrative 4: I told my friends that I have no interest in the social media accounts of fast-food chains. If I want to look at fake food, I'll buy some Twinkies.

Author: eb
Title: May 29th
Body: A friendly, eco-conscious neighbor just stopped by to inform you it's Learn About Composting Day today, and he is offering you a free bag of one of his favorite composting materials.
Narrative 1: A friendly, eco-conscious neighbor gave me a free bag of eggshells on Learn About Composting Day.
Choice 2: A bag of used coffee grounds
Narrative 2: A friendly, eco-conscious neighbor gave me a free bag of used coffee grounds on Learn About Composting Day.
Narrative 3: A friendly, eco-conscious neighbor gave me a free bag of organic manure on Learn About Composting Day.
Narrative 4: A friendly, eco-conscious neighbor stopped by offering free composting materials on Learn About Composting Day, but I graciously declined, saying he should dump it in his own pile instead.

Author: eb
Title: May 30th
Body: Some friends have invited you over to celebrate National Mint Julep Day today, and they're asking you to contribute one of the four essential ingredients needed to make the classic cocktail.
Narrative 1: On National Mint Julep Day, I brought a bottle of Maker's Mark Single Barrel bourbon over to my friend's house, and we partied hard while enjoying the eponymous cocktail.
Narrative 2: On National Mint Julep Day, I brought some fresh mint over to my friend's house, and we partied hard while enjoying the eponymous cocktail.
Narrative 3: On National Mint Julep Day, I brought some sugar over to my friend's house, and we partied hard while enjoying the eponymous cocktail.
Narrative 4: On National Mint Julep Day, I brought some water over to my friend's house, and we partied hard while enjoying the eponymous cocktail.

Author: eb
Title: May 31st
Body: It's World No Tobacco Day, and there's a chainsmoking co-worker at your workplace who's going through a nic-fit and driving everyone crazy. Your supervisor asks you for suggestions on how to help your co-worker cope with his withdrawal symptoms.
Narrative 1: I told my co-worker that his quantum vibrational energies are misaligned due to nicotine withdrawal, and he should try electroshock therapy to help get his life back in balance.
Narrative 2: I told my co-worker that his quantum vibrational energies are misaligned due to nicotine withdrawal, and he should use essential oils to help get back in balance.
Narrative 3: I told my co-worker that his quantum vibrational energies are misaligned due to nicotine withdrawal, and he should try hypnosis to help get his life back in balance.
Narrative 4: I told my co-worker that his quantum vibrational energies are misaligned due to nicotine withdrawal, and he should play BitLife to help get his life back in balance.

Author: RT
Title: June 1st
Body: Global Day of Parents has finally arrived, and you're considering ways that you can show appreciation for your mother and father.
Narrative 1: I used my finest crayons to construct a card for my mother and father in honor of Global Day of Parents. They were blown away by my thoughtfulness, but even more so by my amazing artistic talent.
Narrative 2: In honor of Global Day of Parents, I used every bit of cooking expertise I had to prepare an exquisite three-course dinner for my mother and father. First they enjoyed some crackers topped with tuna and peanut butter, followed by a grilled cheese and marshmallow sandwich, before finishing with popcorn filled Jell-O.
Choice 3: Build them a shrine of myself
Narrative 3: I built a shrine in my parents' bedroom using 65 candlelit photos of myself as a way of showing them my appreciation on Global Day of Parents.
Choice 4: I don't have time for that
Narrative 4: I decided I didn't have time to participate in Global Day of Parents. I love them, but I had video games to play!

Author: RT
Title: June 2nd
Body: Just before going in for a routine dental cleaning, you realize that today is I Love My Dentist Day. Now you're thinking of ways to appropriately express some love for your dentist.
Narrative 1: I gave my dentist a toothbrush as a gift in honor of I Love My Dentist Day. I hope he appreciates it!
Narrative 2: I gave my dentist some candy as a gift in honor of I Love My Dentist Day. I hope he has a sweet tooth!
Narrative 3: I gave my dentist a personalized bobblehead as a gift in honor of I Love My Dentist Day.
Narrative 4: I showed appreciation for my dentist on I Love My Dentist Day by paying the bill for my check-up.

Author: RT
Title: June 3rd
Body: You and <friend> are playing around on the internet when you discover that today is National Itch Day. You start discussing annoying itches when <he/she> asks where you think is the worst place to have an itch.
Narrative 1: On National Itch Day, I told <friend> that the worst place to get an itch is on the middle of my back, because it makes me look like a bear when I brush up against a tree to scratch it.
Narrative 2: On National Itch Day, I told <friend> that the worst place to get an itch is on my bottom because I don't want to get caught scratching my butt.
Narrative 3: On National Itch Day, I told <friend> that the worst place to get an itch is on my crotch because everyone thinks I'm playing with myself when I scratch it.
Narrative 4: On National Itch Day, I told <friend> that the worst place to get an itch is on my eye because I don't want to accidentally scratch my eyeball.

Author: RT
Title: June 4th
Body: You realize it's National Hug Your Cat Day today because your coworker, a crazy cat lady, has brought her favorite feline to work, and she's requesting that everyone embrace her cute little kitty.
Narrative 1: I ran to the bathroom to avoid a coworker who wanted everybody in the office to hug her kitty in honor of National Hug Your Cat Day.
Narrative 2: I gave a big hug to a cute little kitty that my coworker brought to work in honor of National Hug Your Cat Day.
Narrative 3: My coworker wanted me to hug her cat in honor of National Hug Your Cat Day, but I politely declined.
Narrative 4: I reported a coworker to HR for bringing her cat to work and trying to get everyone in the office to hug it. She must have misunderstood the meaning of National Hug Your Cat Day!

Author: RT
Title: June 5th
Body: It's Hot Air Balloon Day, and <lover> has surprised you with a private ride for just the two of you, and of course, the pilot. While flying high above a farm, you start to think about ways to make the most of the flight.
Choice 1: Drop water balloons on the farmers
Narrative 1: <lover> and I decided it would be fun to drop water balloons at the farmers below while taking a ride over farm country on Hot Air Balloon Day. They responded by throwing crops at us, but luckily we were too high for them to hit us.
Narrative 2: <lover> and I missed most of the view while on a flight during Hot Air Balloon Day, because we were getting at it the entire ride. It was super hot for everyone, except the pilot, who seemed extremely annoyed and uncomfortable.
Narrative 3: The captain of a hot air balloon was kind enough to let me take over piloting duties while <lover> and I enjoyed a flight on Hot Air Balloon Day. I nearly hit a tree, but overall I think I impressed everyone with my skills as an aviator.
Narrative 4: I put an arm around <lover> and embraced the moment, as we took in the breathtaking views during a flight over some gorgeous countryside on Hot Air Balloon Day.

Author: RT
Title: June 6th
Body: In honor of National Eyewear Day today, <lover> wants to take advantage of the blowout sales by getting a new pair of glasses and asks you which style will look best on <his/her> beautiful face.
Narrative 1: <lover> came home looking like the ace hipster after <he/she> purchased a very stylish pair of shades at a blowout sale on National Eyewear Day. Then <he/she> thanked me for encouraging <him/her> to do so.
Narrative 2: <lover> came home looking like a super sexy librarian after purchasing a pair of non-prescription reading glasses at a blowout sale on National Eyewear Day.
Narrative 3: <lover> came home looking more sophisticated and refined after purchasing a very classy pair of shades at a blowout sale on National Eyewear Day. Then <he/she> thanked me for encouraging <him/her> to do so.
Narrative 4: I told <lover> that I couldn't give <him/her> fashion advice, after <he/she> asked me what type of eyewear <he/she> should get on National Eyewear Day. I mean, has <he/she> seen my clothes?

Author: RT
Title: June 7th
Body: While hanging out at <friend-possessive> house, <he/she> tells you that today is National Chocolate Ice Cream Day and <he/she> has a freezer full of various types of chocolate ice cream. <he/she> asks which one you most want to eat to celebrate this special day.
Choice 1: Ben & Jerry's Peanut Butter Fudge Core
Narrative 1: To honor National Chocolate Ice Cream Day, I indulged in a pint of chocolate and peanut butter ice cream with mini peanut butter cups and a peanut butter fudge core. Ben & Jerry say, "Vermont's Finest," but I say, "World's Greatest"!
Narrative 2: I treated myself to a pint of Baskin-Robbins Rocky Road ice cream while hanging out at my friend's house on National Chocolate Ice Cream Day. That's as good as it gets!
Narrative 3: I devoured a pint of chocolate Haagen-Dazs ice cream at my friend's house on National Chocolate Ice Cream Day. Plain chocolate is so perfect that adding anything extra would tarnish its delightful purity.
Narrative 4: My friend offered me an assortment of chocolate ice creams on National Chocolate Ice Cream Day, but instead, I went to Yogurtland and crushed some vanilla-flavored frozen yogurt. It was my way of rebelling!

Author: RT
Title: June 8th
Body: While sitting in class listening to your teacher lecture about World Oceans Day, a classmate asks, "How many oceans are there in the world?" Your teacher turns to you and asks if you can answer that question.
Narrative 1: I told my teacher and my classmates that there are four oceans in the world, including the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, the Indian Ocean, and the Arctic Ocean. Everyone seemed satisfied with my answer.
Narrative 2: I told my teacher and my classmates that there are five oceans in the world, including the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, the Indian Ocean, the Arctic Ocean, and the Southern Ocean. Everyone seemed impressed with my answer.
Narrative 3: I told my teacher and my classmates that there is but one ocean in the world. Not only did I blow the minds of my classmates and teacher, but I think my entire class experienced a paradigm shift.
Narrative 4: I told my teacher, and my classmates that I didn't have a clue how many oceans exist in the world, but that I would love to see Frank Ocean at Coachella.

Author: JC
Title: June 9th
Body: While sitting on a park bench enjoying a cup of coffee, a young boy approaches you saying that today is National Donald Duck Day! He then smugly asks if you know the name of Donald's third nephew. There's Huey, Louie, and...?
Narrative 1: A young boy laughed at me after I guessed that "Phooey" was the name of Donald Duck's third nephew. Aw phooey.
Narrative 2: A young boy laughed at me after I guessed that "Stewie" was the name of Donald Duck's third nephew. Aw phooey.
Narrative 3: A young boy was surprised that I knew that Donald Duck's third nephew was named Dewey. I'd been watching Disney long before that boy was born!
Narrative 4: A young boy called me a boomer after I couldn't answer his question about Donald Duck's extended family.

Author: RT
Title: June 10th
Body: While enjoying a dinner party at <friend-possessive> house, someone points out that today is National Herb and Spice Day. The discussion then turns into a thought experiment asking, "If you could only use one herb or spice for the rest of your life, what would it be"?
Narrative 1: While discussing National Herb and Spice Day, I told my friends that if I could only use one spice for the rest of my life, I would choose chili powder. I like it hot!
Narrative 2: I told my friends that if I could only have one herb or spice to use for the rest of my life, I would choose garlic. A friend chimed in, noting that I would never have to worry about vampires.
Narrative 3: I told my friends that if I could only have one herb or spice to use for the rest of my life, I would choose salt. My friends made fun of me and informed me that salt is a mineral, not an herb or spice.
Narrative 4: I told my friends that if I could only have one herb or spice to use for the rest of my life, I would choose pumpkin spice. I explained that I would never go one autumn season without my beloved pumpkin spice latte!

Author: RT
Title: June 11th
Body: While enjoying breakfast with your parents, your mother informs you that today is National Making Life Beautiful Day, and she wants you to join her in doing some charity work of your choosing.
Narrative 1: I spent a lovely day working in a community garden with my mother as a way to celebrate National Making Life Beautiful Day. Life is beautiful!
Narrative 2: My mother and I got a mani-pedi at a spa downtown as a way to participate in National Making Life Beautiful Day. Sure we didn't help others, but we were looking oh so good!
Narrative 3: My mother and I spent a day helping to build a house for a family in need, with Habitat for Humanity, as a way to celebrate National Making Life Beautiful Day. Life is good!
Narrative 4: I told my mother that I would prefer to stay at home on National Making Life Beautiful Day. I've got no beauty to give!

Author: RT
Title: June 12th
Body: While scrolling through your news feed, you discover that today is Magic Day, and you decide to explore YouTube to learn a new magic trick that will impress your friends.
Narrative 1: I spent most of Magic Day learning how to do a vanishing coin trick. I impressed a 5-year-old at the grocery store with that clever optical illusion!
Choice 2: Rabbit out of a hat trick
Narrative 2: I spent most of Magic Day learning how to perform the rabbit out of a hat trick. Then I had to figure out what to do with the rabbit!
Narrative 3: I spent all of Magic Day impressing people with my ability to mysteriously identify the card they chose from the deck. Watch out, David Copperfield!
Narrative 4: I decided that I wouldn't learn any tricks on Magic Day, but I did make a full plate of chocolate chip cookies disappear.

Author: RT
Title: June 13th
Body: While relaxing in your backyard, the next-door neighbor shouts at you over the fence, saying, "Howdy ho neighbor, it's June 13th! Hope you're enjoying Weed Your Garden Day!" Now that you're aware of the holiday, you begin thinking of ways to participate.
Narrative 1: After learning from my neighbor that it was Weed Your Garden Day, I spent an afternoon pulling out all the weeds in my garden. My back was sore for a week!
Narrative 2: I let my hoe do the work as I removed all the invasive vegetation growing in my yard on Weed Your Garden Day. I then tried to use the hoe to trim my bush, but it didn't go so well!
Narrative 3: I seeded five marijuana plants in my yard in honor of Weed Your Garden Day. A friend later informed me that I had misinterpreted the meaning of the holiday.
Narrative 4: I didn't participate in Weed Your Garden Day, but I did enjoy sitting amongst my many weeds while I relaxed and read a magazine.

Author: RT
Title: June 14th
Body: Today is International Bath Day, and as you're doing some research online regarding this unusual holiday, you come upon a Quora forum in which someone has asked, "Why don't American men like to bathe?".
Narrative 1: On International Bath Day, I responded to a Quora forum post, which asked why American men don't like to bathe. I said I believed the typical American male thinks that bathing is gross because the tub is typically dirty, and he feels like he's wading in his own filth. Someone responded by suggesting he clean his tub before bathing.
Narrative 2: On International Bath Day, I responded to a Quora forum post that asked why American men don't like to bathe. I replied by saying the typical American male thinks bathing is not very masculine, and it makes him feel insecure about his manhood.
Narrative 3: On International Bath Day, I responded to a Quora forum post that asked why American men don't like to bathe. I replied by saying I believe that the typical American male doesn't understand the healing benefits of warm water. Someone responded by asking, "Haven't they ever been in a hot tub? It feels heavenly!".
Choice 4: I'm soaking in bubbles at the moment!
Narrative 4: On International Bath Day, I responded to a Quora forum post that asked why American men don't like to bathe. I replied by saying it's not true because I soak every day in an Epsom salt bubble bath while responding to Quora posts. Someone replied by saying, "That sounds dangerous!".

Author: RT
Title: June 15th
Body: While sitting in class listening to the morning announcements, you learn that today is Justice for Janitors Day, a day commemorating the fight for the rights of janitors. The announcement concludes by encouraging everyone to show some love for the school custodian, janitor Dan, to honor this day.
Narrative 1: I attended a rally with my parents on Justice for Janitors Day as a way to show our support for the hard-working custodians in our country.
Narrative 2: I got the entire school chanting, "You're the man, Janitor Dan!" as a way to show our custodian some love on Justice for Janitors Day.
Narrative 3: I gave Janitor Dan a tremendous high-five to show him some love on Justice for Janitors Day, then I promptly washed my hands for two minutes.
Choice 4: Don't walk on his freshly mopped floor
Narrative 4: I decided that I would show my school janitor some respect on Justice for Janitors Day by not walking across his freshly mopped floor. I got you, janitor Dan!

Author: RT
Title: June 16th
Body: While enjoying a nice dinner with <lover>, you hear a commercial on the radio saying it's National Vinegar Day today. <he/she> asks you what you think is the most amazing aspect of vinegar.
Narrative 1: While discussing National Vinegar Day, I told <lover> that vinegar is most amazing as a cleaning product. I added that its sanitizing, deodorizing, and softening qualities give it an edge over all of its more toxic competitors.
Narrative 2: I told <lover> that vinegar was put on this earth to be consumed in the form of food. I love me some salt and vinegar chips!
Choice 3: Vinegar is best for killing weeds
Narrative 3: I told <lover> that vinegar is most beneficial to humans as a weed killer. I added that we don't have to spray toxic chemicals in our gardens to keep out unwanted plants.
Choice 4: Vinegar is a key douche ingredient
Narrative 4: I told <lover> that, without a doubt, vinegar is most beneficial as the key ingredient in a proper douche. She responded by telling me that sounds like something a "douche canoe" would say, and then informed me that I would be sleeping on the couch.

Author: eb
Title: June 17th
Body: In honor of Global Garbage Man Day today, you want to gift something special to your neighborhood sanitation worker to show your sincere appreciation for all the hard work he's been doing.
Narrative 1: In honor of Global Garbage Man Day, I gave our neighborhood sanitation worker a 12-pack of high-alcohol craft beer.
Narrative 2: In honor of Global Garbage Man Day, I wrote a thoughtful thank you note for our neighborhood sanitation worker.
Narrative 3: In honor of Global Garbage Man Day, I gave our neighborhood sanitation worker a 2-pack of antiperspirant/deodorant.
Narrative 4: In honor of Global Garbage Man Day, I gave our neighborhood sanitation worker a pair of leather work gloves.

Author: JC
Title: June 18th
Body: It's National Sushi Day today, and while you're scrolling through Buzzfeed, you discover an online questionnaire asking which of the sauces typically served alongside sushi do you identify with the most.
Narrative 1: On National Sushi Day, I answered a Buzzfeed questionnaire by saying the sauce I most identify with while eating sushi is soy sauce. It's classic, bold, and goes with anything!
Narrative 2: On National Sushi Day, I answered a Buzzfeed questionnaire by saying the sauce I most identify with while eating sushi is eel sauce. It's sweet, rich, and flavorful!
Narrative 3: On National Sushi Day, I answered a Buzzfeed questionnaire by saying the sauce I most identify with while eating sushi is spicy mayo sauce. It's creamy, rich, and has a kick!
Narrative 4: On National Sushi Day, I answered a Buzzfeed questionnaire by saying the sauce I most identify with while eating sushi is none of the sauces. I can't do raw fish.

Author: JC
Title: June 19th
Body: A friend just showed up at your house with a bottle of vodka in his hand saying it's National Martini Day. He then asks if you'll prepare some martinis that would satisfy the sophisticated palate of secret agent 007.
Narrative 1: My friend was disappointed with me after I stirred his 007 style martini. It was supposed to be shaken!
Narrative 2: My friend was delighted by the taste of my perfectly executed, shaken, 007 style martini.
Narrative 3: My friend thought I did an okay job making him a martini fit for agent 007 himself. He said I needed to shake it!
Narrative 4: I couldn't make my friend a martini fit for agent 007 because I had no clue who, or what, that was.

Author: JC
Title: June 20th
Body: After learning that today is New Identity Day, you begin daydreaming about an alter universe where things are done much differently. You begin to fantasize about other possible identities that you could have in this alternate universe.
Narrative 1: On New Identity Day, I daydreamed about the prospect of being an astronaut. It was out of this world.
Narrative 2: On New Identity Day, I daydreamed about the prospect of being a fortune teller. The cards were in my favor.
Narrative 3: On New Identity Day, I daydreamed about the prospect of being a vagabond. It was unsettling.
Narrative 4: On New Identity Day, I daydreamed about the many different identities I could've had in this life, but ultimately concluded I loved my life as is!

Author: eb
Title: June 21st
Body: In honor of International Yoga Day today, some of your friends are asking you to join them in an extreme yoga pose-off where you choose a public location and hold a pose for 30 minutes.
CTA: Where and what will you choose?
Choice 1: Down dog in a pet store
Narrative 1: On International Yoga Day, I went to a pet store and struck an amazing down dog pose for 30 minutes.
Narrative 2: On International Yoga Day, I went to a suspension bridge and struck a fantastic bridge pose for 30 minutes.
Choice 3: Chair pose in a furniture store
Narrative 3: On International Yoga Day, I went to a furniture store and struck a fantastic chair pose for 30 minutes.
Narrative 4: I declined an invitation to join some friends who wanted to do extreme yoga pose-offs on International Yoga Day. I told them namast'ay in bed!

Author: eb
Title: June 22nd
Body: To commemorate Stupid Guy Thing Day today, you and your friends want to laugh at guys doing stupid things, and they're asking you for suggestions on what to watch.
Narrative 1: In honor of Stupid Guy Thing Day, I watched FailArmy with some friends, and we all laughed our heads off watching guys doing stupid things.
Narrative 2: In honor of Stupid Guy Thing Day, I watched Jackass with some friends, and we all laughed our jackasses off watching guys doing stupid things.
Narrative 3: In honor of Stupid Guy Thing Day, I watched 'Dumb and Dumber' with some friends, and we all laughed our heads off watching guys doing stupid things.
Narrative 4: In honor of Stupid Guy Thing Day, I watched a fraternity hazing on YouTube with some friends. I was amazed at some of the stupid things those guys did to pledge a fraternity.

Author: JC
Title: June 23rd
Body: While walking through the mall, a slender woman with an obnoxious smile approaches you holding a clipboard in her hand. She explains that today is National Hydration Day, and she is surveying the public's knowledge of how much water a person should be drinking each day.
Narrative 1: I told a curious woman that I believed people should drink two liters of water a day to be healthy. She complimented my hydration knowledge!
Narrative 2: I told a curious woman that I believed people should drink eight glasses of water each day to be healthy. She complimented my hydration knowledge!
Narrative 3: I told a curious woman that I believed people should drink a half-gallon of water each day to be healthy. She complimented my hydration knowledge!
Narrative 4: I told a curious woman at the mall that I didn't care how much water people need to drink each day. She then told me that's why my skin looked so bad.

Author: RT
Title: June 24th
Body: You're relaxing on the couch watching 'Night at the Museum' as a way to celebrate Museum Comes to Life Day. During a commercial break, your mind starts to wander, and you begin thinking about which exhibit you would most like to see come alive.
Narrative 1: While reflecting on Museum Comes to Life Day, I decided that if I could see one exhibit come to life, it would be the Tyrannosaurus rex. I would watch its reign of terror from the 3rd level of the museum, before making my great escape from a helicopter on the roof.
Narrative 2: While reflecting on Museum Comes to Life Day, I decided that if I could see one exhibit come to life, it would be a perfectly chiseled, Greek demigod statue. How can I serve thee, your holiness?!
Narrative 3: While reflecting on Museum Comes to Life Day, I decided that if I could see one exhibit come to life, it would be a life-size wax figure of Harry Styles. I'd stay up all night asking him every question I've ever wondered about!
Narrative 4: While reflecting on Museum Comes to Life Day, I decided that if I could see one exhibit come to life, it would be an enormous venus fly trap. I'd sit back and observe from a distance to see what it chose to feast upon.

Author: JC
Title: June 25th
Body: It's Global Beatles Day today, and a conversation amongst you and some friends contorts into a satirical debate over which Beatle should be considered the most iconic of the fab-four.
Narrative 1: On Global Beatles Day, I told my friends that Paul McCartney was the most iconic of all four Beatles. He was the face of the group!
Narrative 2: On Global Beatles Day, I told my friends that George Harrison was the most iconic of all four Beatles. He was the group's spine!
Narrative 3: I undoubtedly think that John Lennon was the most iconic of all four Beatles. He was the real mastermind of the group!
Narrative 4: On Global Beatles Day, I told my friends that Ringo Starr was the most iconic of all four Beatles. He was the soul of the group!

Author: eb
Title: June 26th
Body: One of your friends is a beautician, and in honor of National Beautician's Day today, you want to give her a special gift.
Narrative 1: For National Beautician's Day, I gave my beautician friend a pair of Centrix Koi professional shears.

Author: eb
Title: June 27th
Body: You're hosting a high-stakes bingo game at a local nursing home on National Bingo Day when you accidentally read out the wrong number. Immediately, a sweet old lady, who has never won a game, excitedly screams out BINGO!
Narrative 1: I volunteered to host a high-stakes bingo game at a nursing home and accidentally called out the wrong number, inadvertently throwing the game. But after seeing a sweet old woman excitedly "win," I decided to just keep the mistake to myself.
Narrative 2: I volunteered to host a high-stakes bingo game at a nursing home and accidentally called out the wrong number, inadvertently throwing the game. Even though a sweet older woman thought she had won, I played by the rules and announced my mistake.
Narrative 3: I volunteered to host a high-stakes bingo game at a nursing home and accidentally called out the wrong number, inadvertently throwing the game. So I immediately ran out of the building and never returned.

Author: eb
Title: June 28th
Body: In honor of International Body Piercing Day today, you decide you want to flex on your friends by getting a new piercing in an obscure part of your body.
Narrative 1: In honor of International Body Piercing Day, I got my uvula pierced with a 14-gauge captive ring bead. It was excruciatingly painful, but I played it off legit.

Author: RT
Title: July 1st

Author: RT
Title: July 2nd
Body: You're home alone watching TV when you learn that today is World UFO Day. You begin to start thinking about aliens, which makes you curious to learn more about the topic.
Narrative 1: On World UFO Day, I stayed up all night watching videos and reading accounts of people who claim to have seen actual aliens inside Area 51.

Author: eb
Title: July 3rd

Narrative 1: In honor of American Redneck Day, I distilled me some good ol' rotgut moonshine that was so potent I ended up making good friends with a possum.
Narrative 2: In honor of American Redneck Day, I went down to the crick with Earl, Billy Ray, Dwayne, and Clyde, and we caught us some crawdads, and then Dixie's momma cooked 'em up while we drank Pabst Blue Ribbon tall boys on the front porch.

Choice 4: Cut the sleeves off my flannel

Title: July 4th

Author: RT
Title: July 5th
Body: You and your <bruv/bro/buddy/main man/homeboy/best dude/homie> have been invited to a pool party. Just before the event, he calls you to say it's International Bikini Day today, and it would be hilarious if you both wear bikinis to the party.
Narrative 1: My <rb> and I were the life of a pool party after we showed up wearing itsy bitsy microkinis in honor of International Bikini Day. We had a blast but went home with sunburns on 98% of our bodies.
Narrative 2: My <rb> and I were the life of a pool party after we showed up wearing tankinis, in honor of International Bikini Day. It was a bit embarrassing, but at least I was able to cover up my gut.
Narrative 3: My <rb> and I were the life of a pool party after we showed up wearing skirtinis, in honor of International Bikini Day. It was a bit embarrassing, but at least I was able to cover up my chubby thighs.
Narrative 4: I went to a pool party wearing swim trunks, even though my <rb> and I had agreed to wear bikinis together, in honor of International Bikini Day. It was hilarious to see him realize that he was the only guy wearing one, and even funnier to see him throw a temper tantrum in a two-piece bathing suit.

Author: RT
Title: July 6th
Body: Today is International Kissing Day, and you want to share a kiss with someone. Since you don't have a significant other, you'll need to decide who that lucky person will be.
Narrative 1: I gave my mom a kiss on the cheek in honor of International Kissing Day. It was my way of telling her that she is my number one lady!
Narrative 2: I kissed my neighbor's baby on the forehead in honor of International Kissing Day. She was just the cutest thing ever!
Narrative 3: A random hottie agreed to kiss me on the lips in honor of International Kissing Day. It was the best day ever!
Narrative 4: I tried to kiss my cousin on the mouth in honor of International Kissing Day, but she punched me in the mouth.

Author: RT
Title: July 7th
Body: You're hanging out with some friends on World Chocolate Day when <friend> proclaims that Reese's Peanut Butter Cups are the best candy ever. A heated debate suddenly sparks over which is better, the chocolate or the peanut butter.
Narrative 1: On World Chocolate Day, I told my friends that chocolate is superior to peanut butter because it releases dopamine, serotonin, endorphins, and oxytocin in the brain when consumed, so it tastes and feels amazing.
Narrative 2: On World Chocolate Day, I told my friends that peanut butter is superior to chocolate because it's the perfect combo of salty and sweet, and oh so thick and creamy.
Narrative 3: On World Chocolate Day, I told my friends that I couldn't choose between chocolate and peanut butter because they both make my life so much better.
Narrative 4: On World Chocolate Day, I told my friends that neither chocolate nor peanut butter is something that I enjoy. The vibe got weird for a moment before my friends started making lame excuses to leave.

Author: RT
Title: July 8th
Body: You're relaxing on the patio with friends when <friend> informs everyone that it's Be a Kid Again Day today. The group starts throwing out ideas on ways to relive your childhood, and they ask you which one sounds the most fun.
Narrative 1: In honor of Be a Kid Again Day, my friends and I played hide-and-seek. It took us an hour and a half to find <friend> because <he/she> was "hiding" at a local pub, drinking margaritas.
Narrative 2: In honor of Be a Kid Again Day, my friends and I built a fort. It took us three hours to construct, but only five minutes to destroy because <friend-possessive> clumsy ass knocked the whole thing over.
Narrative 3: In honor of Be a Kid Again Day, my friends and I played house. The game didn't last long though, because <friend> and I got into a fight over who would be the mommy.
Narrative 4: In honor of Be a Kid Again Day, my friends and I played a game of pickup basketball. It didn't go well, though, because we all went home a little banged up, and <friend> tore <his/her> Achilles tendon.

Author: RT
Title: July 9th
Body: It's Fashion Day, and you are out shopping with <friend>. <He/She> tries on an outfit that <he/she> really loves, but you think it's ugly, and it looks ridiculous. <He/She> asks you what you think.
Narrative 1: While shopping with <friend> on Fashion Day, I told <him/her> that a hideous, unflattering outfit that <he/she> tried on was not the right one for <him/her>. Luckily, I was able to convince <him/her> not to buy it without hurting <his/her> feelings.
Narrative 2: While shopping with <friend> on Fashion Day, I told <him/her> that a hideous, unflattering outfit that <he/she> tried on was ugly as hell. <He/She> decided not to buy it when I added that I couldn't be seen walking around with someone looking like that.
Narrative 3: While shopping with <friend> on Fashion Day, I told <him/her> that a hideous, unflattering outfit <he/she> tried on was perfect for <him/her>. <He/She> decided to buy it, which excited me because I couldn't wait to see people's reactions.
Narrative 4: I told <friend> to not ask my opinion about a hideous, unflattering outfit <he/she> tried on while we were shopping on Fashion Day. Some other shoppers snickered as they walked by, so <he/she> decided not to buy the outfit.

Author: RT
Holiday Name: Don't Step on a Bee Day
Title: July 10th
Body: While frolicking barefoot in your garden, casually scrolling through social media, you see a post that says today is Don't Step on a Bee Day. Suddenly, you feel a sharp pain on the bottom of your foot and look down to discover that you just stepped on a bee!
Choice 1: Vow to never disturb a bee again
Narrative 1: I vowed to never again step on a bee after accidentally stomping on one during Don't Step on a Bee Day. On my honor!
Narrative 2: I created a memorial for a bee that I accidentally crushed on Don't Step on a Bee Day. Never forget!
Narrative 3: I volunteered at a honey farm after accidentally crushing a bee on Don't Step on a Bee Day. It was pretty sweet!
Narrative 4: I decided to not do anything, other than take a Benadryl, after accidentally stomping on a honey bee during Don't Step on a Bee Day.

Author: RT
Title: July 11th
Body: While sitting in class on World Population Day listening to a lecture on the world's rising population, you start daydreaming about how many children you'd like to have when you're older.
Narrative 1: On World Population Day, I decided that I wanted to have two children. One to eventually replace me and one to replace my hypothetical future spouse.
Narrative 2: On World Population Day, I decided I would like to have one child because I definitely want to have a kid, but I don't want to contribute to overpopulation issues.
Narrative 3: On World Population Day, I decided I would like to have nine children. Ten just seemed like too many.
Narrative 4: On World Population Day, I decided I didn't want to have any children because the world already had enough problems due to overpopulation.

Author: RT
Title: July 12th
Body: National Simplicity Day has arrived, and as you and <friend> are discussing the holiday, <he/she> asks you how you think <he/she> should simplify <his/her> life.
Narrative 1: On National Simplicity Day, I told <friend> that <he/she> needs to slow down a bit. I added that <he/she> should start by focusing on taking one breath at a time.
Choice 2: Get rid of stuff you don't need
Narrative 2: On National Simplicity Day, I told <friend> that <he/she> needs to declutter by getting rid of things <he/she> doesn't need. I added that a couple of episodes of 'Tidying Up' with Marie Kondo might be a good start.
Narrative 3: On National Simplicity Day, I told <friend> that <he/she> needs to start appreciating the small things in life, like pretty sunsets or a sky full of stars.
Choice 4: You already are a basic bitch!
Narrative 4: On National Simplicity Day, I told <friend> that <he/she> is already a basic bitch, and that <he/she> may struggle to find ways to live a more simple life.

Author: RT
Title: July 13th
Body: You're hanging out with <friend> on National Embrace Your Geekness Day, when <he/she> suggests that you both go to a local event to celebrate your geekness.
Narrative 1: <friend> and I went to play in a video game tournament on National Embrace Your Geekness Day. I was crowned the #1 geek after winning first place in the Super Smash Bros tournament.
Narrative 2: <friend> and I went to an anime convention on National Embrace Your Geekness Day. We dressed up as Jessie and James of Team Rocket and had a blast going around stealing other people's Pok\351mon.
Narrative 3: <friend> and I went to play in a video game tournament on National Embrace Your Geekness Day. I was crowned the #1 geek after winning first place in the Dungeons & Dragons tournament.
Narrative 4: I told <friend> that I wasn't a geek when <he/she> suggested that we go to an event to celebrate National Embrace Your Geekness Day. <He/She> thought about it for a moment, then agreed, saying that I probably would qualify more as a nerd than a geek.

Author: RT
Title: July 14th
Body: You are hanging out with friends on National Mac and Cheese Day discussing the many varieties of this classic food when <friend> asks what you think is the tastiest ingredient added to mac and cheese.
Narrative 1: On National Mac and Cheese Day, I told my friends that the tastiest ingredient added to mac and cheese is bacon. No one in the group disagreed.
Narrative 2: On National Mac and Cheese Day, I told my friends that the tastiest ingredient added to mac and cheese is lobster. They laughed and then <friend> said to me that lobsters are the cockroaches of the sea.
Narrative 3: On National Mac and Cheese Day, I told my friends that the tastiest ingredient added to mac and cheese is broccoli. I explained that I like to keep it delicious and healthy.
Narrative 4: On National Mac and Cheese Day, I told my friends that the tastiest ingredient added to mac and cheese is more cheese. I said that you could never have enough cheese.

Author: RT
Title: July 15th
Body: You just learned that today is National Give Something Away Day, and you're considering donating something that you no longer need as a way of giving back.
Narrative 1: I donated some of my clothing to charity on National Give Something Away Day. It felt good to give back!
Narrative 2: I donated a couch, and all the items stuck inside it, to charity on National Give Something Away Day.
Narrative 3: I tried giving away <lover> on National Give Something Away Day. Unfortunately, there were no takers.
Narrative 4: I decided to not participate in National Give Something Away Day because I had nothing to give.

Author: RT
Title: July 16th
Body: In celebration of World Snake Day, you and <friend> are checking out all the slithering snakes inside the zoo's serpentarium. Without warning, the building begins to shake, and you realize you're experiencing an earthquake. You start searching for an exit when someone shouts, "The snakes are getting out!".
Choice 1: The exit next to the cobras
Narrative 1: I escaped a serpentarium during an earthquake by using an exit near the cobras. A king cobra struck at me, but luckily I was unharmed. It was a terrifying, albeit exhilarating way to celebrate World Snake Day.
Choice 2: The exit next to the anacondas
Narrative 2: I escaped a serpentarium during an earthquake by using an exit near the anacondas. A giant green anaconda struck at me, but luckily I was unharmed. It was a terrifying, albeit exhilarating way to celebrate World Snake Day.
Choice 3: The exit next to the garter snakes
Narrative 3: I escaped a serpentarium during an earthquake by using an exit near the garter snakes. One of them bit me on the leg as I ran by, leaving two small puncture wounds on my ankle. I went immediately to the first-aid station, but both the staff and <friend> laughed at me and told me I would be fine.
Narrative 4: I stayed inside a serpentarium despite the fact that snakes had escaped their enclosures during an earthquake. I was able to pick up and examine a python and a boa constrictor before the staff asked me to leave. It was an educational and exhilarating way to celebrate World Snake Day.

Author: eb
Title: July 17th
Body: You just got a text from <friend> showing a grinning face emoji, followed by a calendar emoji, followed by an exclamation mark emoji, and you suddenly realize it's World Emoji Day today. <He/She> then sends a follow-up text saying to reply using your favorite emoji only.
Narrative 1: I got a text from my friend on World Emoji Day asking me to reply with my favorite emoji, and I sent a face with tears of joy.
Narrative 2: I got a text from my friend on World Emoji Day asking me to reply with my favorite emoji, and I sent back a red heart.
Narrative 3: I got a text from my friend on World Emoji Day asking me to reply with my favorite emoji, and I sent back a loudly crying face.
Narrative 4: I got a text from my friend on World Emoji Day asking me to reply with my favorite emoji, and I sent back a smiling pile of poop.

Narrative 1: On World Listening Day, I went to a remote location in hopes of hearing the sound of world peace, but I didn't hear it.

Narrative 3: On World Listening Day, I went to a remote location in hopes of hearing the sound of silence, but there was never a time when there weren't any sounds.
Narrative 4: On World Listening Day, I went to a remote location in hopes of hearing the scream of the butterfly, but I never heard it.

Narrative 2: I celebrated National Stick Out Your Tongue Day by sticking out my tongue at stress. Take that!
Narrative 3: I celebrated National Stick Out Your Tongue Day by sticking out my tongue at not having wifi.

Narrative 1: On International Chess Day, I dressed up like a king and majestically walked in the park in any direction I wanted, one slow step at a time.

Author: RT
Holiday Name: Invite an Alien to Live with You Day
Title: July 21st

Narrative 1: On Invite an Alien to Live with You Day, I told my family that I would like to ask ET to come live with us. I added that we'd have to keep an endless supply of Reese's Pieces on hand for that cute little guy.
Narrative 2: On Invite an Alien to Live with You Day, I told my family that I would like to ask Spock from 'Star Trek' to come live with us. I explained that his exceptional use of logic would be quite beneficial in our decision making.

Narrative 4: On Invite an Alien to Live with You Day, I told my family that I'm not interested in having an alien come live with us. I added that we're already too weird of a family as it is.

Author: RT
Title: July 22nd

Narrative 1: I won a contest for a free hammock on National Hammock Day, and I picked out a super comfy rope hammock and tied it between two trees.
Narrative 2: I won a contest for a free hammock on National Hammock Day, and I picked out a super comfy quilted hammock and tied it between two trees.
Narrative 3: I won a contest for a free hammock on National Hammock Day, and I picked out a super comfy banana hammock that made my banana feel very secure and well supported.
Narrative 4: I decided not to redeem an offer for a free hammock I received by email on National Hammock Day. I figured it was probably just spam-scam anyway.

Author: RT
Title: July 23rd

Narrative 2: I spent a long, warm night having sweet, sticky dreams about the most gorgeous grandma alive, Martha Stewart.

Narrative 2: I lost my bikini bottom while flying down a slide at a waterpark and asked a hot lifeguard to help me find it. He dove into the pool, scooped it up off of the bottom, and brought it over to me with his eyes closed. What a chivalrous hottie!

Title: July 29th
